stations.name: Topic selection
checks: Read the latest comment report (reports/comments/) first; rank viewer-question follow-ups with the search picks
Comments = proven demand; run before Sun/Wed topic planning (Joe)
Topic backed by measured search growth (Google Trends, Wikipedia pageviews, TikTok Creator Search Insights)
Topic picks go to Joe first; nothing renders until he chooses
Topic is in the approved week/batch

stations.name: Long vs short
checks: Default VIDEO; carousel only if <6 licensed photos, static list, same-day deadline, or can't fill 63–70 s
Short must land 63–70 s without padding (checked at the File gate)
TikTok payout; Process doc §6 Gate 4 File

stations.name: Wow-factor check
checks: Short: exactly one clear wow; long-form: several
Wow is a curiosity, not a committee 'gap fix' list

stations.name: Hook
checks: Hook passes the Hook gate: voice starts at frame 0; topic + hook of ≤8 words by 2.0 s; full spoken claim ≤12 words by ~3.0 s from the first frame of audio
Judgment question: does this hook state a real, specific claim that would make someone stop scrolling, in plain language? Vague hooks that only pass the word count fail
Headline on screen from frame 1, no fade-in (CAR10)

stations.name: Script & fact-check
checks: 100% of claims sourced; numbers cross-checked with a second source
Every line maps to a fact ID; US units

Structure: twist hook → disaster → how it works → dated numbers ("in October 2026", never "this week"/"last week") → ending. Ending may close on a real "genius or waste" taxpayer-money debate stated in the script; generic comment-bait ("comment below", "let me know") banned
Ending clearly answers the question it raises (no cliffhanger)
Teasers answer the question on the same platform (no 'full answer on YouTube')
NYC water: top TikTok comment complained, 1,260 likes
Script sized for 63–70 s in the voice Joe set for this video (current: Gemini Charon)

stations.name: Shot list & storyboard
checks: No build starts before storyboard APPROVED
No split screens; zoom ≤1.15×; holds ≤3 s; image used ≤2×
boardlint.py PASS on timing.json and shotlist.csv

stations.name: Generation & build
checks: One build round + at most one polish pass; no repeated fix loops
Visuals premium, glassy, photoreal; no flat hand-drawn diagrams
CC credit on the photo only, never in captions
Don't force 24 fps clips to 30 fps or slow-mo by frame repeat
On-screen credit on every footage clip; no stock (Pexels counts); network TV/news only for frame 0 or the opening when clearly the best shot
Process doc §6 Frame gate + Reviewer checklist
Word-for-word captions at bottom of the safe box; orange highlights on key numbers and dollar amounts only, everything else white; middle callouts only for proper names or dates
Subject big in frame and fully visible (never cropped); horizontal footage never placed low in the vertical frame
No repeated shots or looks; a blur keeps a fixed size and shape for the whole shot

stations.name: Voice & music
checks: Voice set per video by Joe (current: Gemini Charon); never pitch-shift or time-stretch a voice
Loudness -14 LUFS integrated (pass -14 ±1), checked once at the Audio gate; no music (except Corey's Great Wall cuts); no whoosh/swoosh transition sounds
Process doc §6 Gate 3 Audio + Reviewer checklist
Listen to the first second for distortion and to the final VO line wording

stations.name: Four gates
stations.gate: All four PASS; any FAIL blocks the post
checks: Gate 1 Hook: VO starts at 0.0 s; hook ≤8 words by 2.0 s; claim ≤12 words by ~3.0 s (from word timestamps)
Gate 2 Frame: frame 0 and cover real, not black/flat; safe_area_gate.py PASS (CUT and MARGIN fail); captions at bottom of safe box
Gate 3 Audio: -14 ±1 LUFS integrated; click check PASS
Gate 4 File: 63–70 s; share copy <30 MB (MAX_MB); 1080x1920; check_smoothness.py PASS on every copy; clean decode
run_gates.sh prints one PASS/FAIL line per gate and exits non-zero on any FAIL
Other build scripts (holdcheck, pace, padcheck, edgecheck, ocrcheck, provcheck, stt_check, layoutgate, check_no_split.py for the X cut) still run as build aids

stations.name: Reviewer
checks: Reviewer checklist, one pass logged in review.md: hard blocks (no guns, AI labels off, licensing) plus the rules no script can check
One judgment question, exact wording in Process doc §6
Reviewer PASS ≠ done; Joe's taste is the bar
Reviewer must not replace a search-backed hook

stations.name: Joe sign-off
checks: Joe OKs hook, first half, and full video
Every rejection logged in rejections.md and turned into a check within 24 h

stations.name: Post kit
checks: 9:16 cut, 16:9 X cut, cover, captions + hashtags
Shorts cover uploaded manually in desktop Studio (API ignores it)
No 'AI' label or AI-voice wording on any platform
Clear local copies after Drive upload sizes verified

stations.name: Posting per platform
checks: Nothing posts without Joe's own yes
TikTok: Joe posts from phone (video, then caption message)
Bot posts YT, FB, IG, X at best times
Check live profile for duplicates before any post
Covers on live videos not changed without Joe's OK
At least 6 hours between posts on the same platform

stations.name: 24h / 72h measurement
checks: Log views at 24 h and 72 h in metrics-log.csv
Bar: 10k views minimum across platforms; 25k+ is good
X numbers are impressions; don't add to views
